# CAL KERNELS (test)

Five machines of synthetic SHARC+ kernels with known instruction counts per render call (alu 20,059, dm 19,968, mem 19,253, branch 20,054, mix 19,964), for the calibration profile `kernels` (`devices/calibration/profiles/kernels.toml`): factors of a device and of the emulator are fitted per kind of instruction. The mix of each kernel and the memory it touches are in the header of `src/dsp/cal_kernels.s`. The machines have no parameter and render silence (mix: a signal below 1e-6) and end their voice after 1400 blocks. A case names a machine as `test/cal-kernels#n` (n counts from 1 in the order of `[[machine]]`). `tests/kernels.rig.test.ts` pins the counts per device; the conformance suite skips the module (about 20,000 instructions a block is over the voice budget by design).
